Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 685 Records detected", "Trading Partners 5", "Ports 9", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-18"; of the 5 shipment rows displayed in the free view, exactly 1 is an outbound (export) record and 4 are inbound imports into Kolkata ACC (from Ningbo/China, Macron Safety Systems UK, Autronica Norway, Tianjin VSAIL China). HS on the export row is 85319000 (parts of fire alarm systems), not the declared 853110 — consistent with the declared product family but a different 6-digit heading.
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split found for GLYPTIC. Search tooling was unavailable during this check (DuckDuckGo/searx returned connection refused), and volza/eximpedia/trademo free views returned HTTP 403, so domestic supply could not be tested. ImportKey lists GLYPTIC as a buyer from Carrier Fire & Security Singapore, Schrack Seconet AG, Securiton AG and Shenzhen Tanda Technology, i.e. it is primarily an importer/distributor of fire-safety equipment into India — domestic resale is plausible but unverified.
note: Address on record: "VILL-RAIPUR, P.O-BHITA" (Kolkata/West Bengal area), importing through Kolkata ACC (INCCU4). Export confirmed by a single dated customs record: 2025-11-22, Petrapole→Benapole (Bangladesh), HS 85319000, BOL 5400721, buyer Supreme Outfit Ltd. Declared HS 853110 vs observed 85319000/85318000/85389000/84818090 — HS should be corrected to the actual codes; per project rule this is not a rejection ground. Domestic supply evidence: not public, recorded as unknown rather than asserted. No revenue or export-volume figures are public in the free views — left null, not estimated.
